Claude: recover the adopted lane/worktree identity outcome of #13177, carrying it through current-source reconciliation, independent review and source delivery. Queue after your existing #20743 work; do not interrupt the preview, count, receipt, deployment, event-reference, scale or attachment commitments already ordered.

Hugh adopted proposal cb755aa1de429cda8322912af29190b9c50415b6 through effective ratification #13451/986a1ca241cdb42abdebb1de1292e168479460ad. Its [exact design](notes/2026-08-27-lane-identity.md@6131249c6a6f86cbd8893bf30f2d582f88bbb274:32), artifact953c3746, promised that planner would file implementation requests after adoption and the note would proceed to independent review/merge. Current history through20818 contains the adoption but no implementation/review/delivery chain for that promise. Current source has no proposed gs worktree command, gitseq.request config or refs/gitseq/lanes index; the retained current CLI rejects worktree as unknown and the lane-ref namespace is empty. Existing Rests-On, target binding, publication and closure mechanisms are related delivered pieces, not evidence that all four layers shipped.

Preserve and account for all four adopted layers: (1) a bounded resident reverse association from implementing-commit Rests-On facts and actual refs/worktrees to durable work; (2) guarded worktree creation/stamping and correct trailer assistance, with defined behavior when a governing lane settles; (3) deterministic lane refs surviving checkout removal, with human branch aliases; (4) validated branch/worktree display fields that do not grant authority. Also preserve the intended ability to identify cleanup candidates after merge and non-merge endings, detect duplicate checkouts and refless heads, and keep mutation-test scratch trees temporary. Reuse current delivered machinery rather than create competing stores or a second lifecycle model.

First reconcile the old 101-line design against current self-initiated work, canonical event resolution, target-bound requests, recuts/reassignment, approved-but-unlanded heads, sealed landing and retirement semantics, multiple actors/repos/worktrees and safe independent review. The old statement that a sealed trailer is unforgeable must not turn arbitrary commit text, local config, refs or body paths into signing or filesystem authority. Separate claimed identity, verified durable assignment/implementation evidence, local location and actual permission. A shared head or expired lease alone does not make a tree removable. Any material simplification, changed policy or omitted adopted layer needs a concrete revised ordinary proposal for Hugh before implementation; silence or a design-only report does not abandon the outcome.

#20787 is separate four-tree operational cleanup and must not be presented as delivery of this tooling. The protected dirty drafts named in #13175/#15447 and every existing worktree remain untouched by this source task. Exercise creation, hooks, refs, settled-lane refusal and cleanup behavior only in isolated fixtures; do not install live hooks or activate fleet cleanup.

body.conditions: Deliver the whole adopted lane/worktree identity outcome on request/lane-worktree-identity from current main, after the existing queue. Publish a concise current design/candidate and resolve materially changed semantics by ordinary Hugh adoption before implementing them; obtain independent review and eventually land the governing note and implementation. All four adopted layers and cleanup/duplicate/refless/scratch consequences must be implemented and proved or explicitly narrowed by an adopted decision, never silently dropped. Preserve kernel semantics and historical bytes; document affected current architecture contracts in the same implementation head. Specify bounded scans/cache invalidation and deterministic ambiguity/refusal behavior; use existing canonical event resolution and current authority/landing facts, including self-initiated work without inventing self-requests. Untrusted trailers/config/refs/path strings are evidence, not permission. Prove actual temporary-Git behavior for branch movement/rename, linked worktrees, recuts, ambiguous/missing/forged/foreign-workroom identities, dirty/locked/used/symlink or out-of-scope paths, retries/CAS or competing creation, settled and merely-stale lanes, approved unlanded candidates, merge and non-merge endings. Observe correct refusal before signing or unsafe filesystem mutation; read-only inventory performs no writes. Verify any helper hook is narrowly scoped and does not replace user hooks or invoke untrusted programs. Use positive controls and real omissions for the claimed authority, identity and cleanup boundaries, with independently specified expected contract values. Run applicable full Go/vet/UI/docset/race gates for changed surfaces, exact-head independent Architecture/Security/Simplification review, review ratification, sealed exact-path succession, source/seq/receipt push, main CI and owned feature-tree/branch cleanup. Keep the parent promise open until the full outcome is delivered; obtain explicit stage children before any partial landing so a design-only merge cannot close the whole implementation. No live existing-tree cleanup, source rewrite/history repair, hook installation, reader/agent restart, key operation or remote-ref deletion. The four-tree cleanup #20787 and other active requests retain their own scope.
